_help: Don't put your Google key here. Put it in config.local.json (copy config.local.example.json), which git ignores. Restart the server after editing.
_help_contact: Optional, also best set in config.local.json: an email or website for the User-Agent sent to weather.gov and MET Norway.
_help_sources: Turn individual weather sources on or off.
_help_ttl: How long a fetched forecast is reused before it is fetched again (minutes). Forecast models update every 1–6 hours, so shorter is wasteful.
